description: The file 'ovsdb_utils.c' contains utility functions for handling various data structures such as sets, trees, and pairs, specifically for strings and integers, often with dynamic memory management. It includes functions to convert static arrays into dynamically allocated data structures, compare, insert, and free elements in trees, and manage memory for custom pair and set structures. The context suggests its role is to facilitate data conversions and memory management within the larger ovsdb utility module.

methods.name: struct:str_set * schema2str_set(size_t elem_size,size_t nelems,char schema_set[][elem_size])
methods.description: Converts a static array of strings into a dynamically allocated set structure, duplicating each string.

methods.name: void free_str_set(struct str_set * set)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a string set structure.

methods.name: int str_tree_cmp(void * a,void * b)
methods.description: Comparison function for string-based tree nodes.

methods.name: struct:str_pair * get_pair(const char * key,const char * value)
methods.description: Creates a key-value string pair for insertion into a tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_t * schema2tree(size_t key_size,size_t value_size,size_t nelems,char keys[][key_size],char values[][value_size])
methods.description: Builds a tree of string pairs from two static arrays of keys and values.

methods.name: void free_str_pair(struct str_pair * pair)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a string pair.

methods.name: void free_str_tree(ds_tree_t * tree)
methods.description: Frees a tree of string pairs.

methods.name: struct:int_set * schema2int_set(size_t nelems,int schema_set[])
methods.description: Converts a static array of integers into a dynamically allocated set structure.

methods.name: void free_int_set(struct int_set * set)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an integer set.

methods.name: struct:str_ipair * get_ipair(const char * key,int value)
methods.description: Creates a key-integer pair for insertion into a tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_t * schema2itree(size_t elem_size,size_t nelems,char keys[][elem_size],int values[])
methods.description: Builds a tree of string-integer pairs from static arrays of keys and integer values.

methods.name: void free_str_ipair(struct str_ipair * pair)

methods.name: void free_str_itree(ds_tree_t * tree)
